previous_statement: Conditional naturality only: if, in addition to the registered definitions, theta is specified to be one fixed holomorphic functional-calculus function on a common neighbourhood of the spectra of T and iota_n(T), then theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This conditional does not establish the required amplification identity from the presently allowed inputs, because def-compressed-corner neither specifies such a functional calculus nor states amplification naturality.
new_statement: For every integer n >= 1, every extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, and every bounded linear operator T:A->A, define the entrywise amplification iota_n(T):M_n tensor A->M_n tensor A by iota_n(T)([X_ij])=[T(X_ij)]. If, in addition to the registered definitions, theta is specified to be one fixed scalar holomorphic function on an open set containing both spectra sigma(T) in B(A) and sigma(iota_n(T)) in B(M_n tensor A), and theta(T), theta(iota_n(T)) are defined by the corresponding holomorphic functional calculi, then theta(iota_n(T))=iota_n(theta(T)). This conditional does not establish the required amplification identity from the presently allowed inputs, because def-compressed-corner neither specifies such a functional calculus nor states amplification naturality.
